why_wallet_address_needed: eth_estimateGas(approve) reverts when from=zero_address or from=an_address_with_zero_token_balance — most tokens (USDT included) check msg.sender's balance during approve transitions on some forks; even when approve doesn't revert, the gas estimate without a `from` field defaults to balance-dependent paths and gives misleading numbers.
eth_estimateGas(mint) MUST have allowance >= amount0Desired and amount1Desired AND sufficient balance, else the simulated execution reverts and no gas is returned.
eth_estimateGas(decreaseLiquidity/collect) requires the wallet to already own the tokenId; without a wallet, no tokenId exists, so estimate is undefined.

Therefore reliable gas estimation MUST happen in the next stage (LP_BSC_10_20U_PROBE_WALLET_ADDRESS_DRY_RUN_V1) where the operator provides a wallet address, balances and allowances can be queried, and eth_estimateGas can be called with from=wallet.
conservative_gas_units_sources: Pancake V3 NPM.mint() observed mainnet range: 250k-400k depending on whether the tickLower/tickUpper need new tick storage initialization
ERC20.approve() observed: 30k-50k (USDT on BSC is a standard BEP-20, no proxy quirk)
PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter.exactInputSingle(): 100k-160k depending on ticks crossed
_total_breakdown: approve(USDT)=50k + approve(WBNB)=50k + mint=380k + decreaseLiquidity=180k + collect=80k + approve(USDT,0)=30k + approve(WBNB,0)=30k + buffer ≈ 870k. Burn optional adds ~30k.

gas_cost_usd_scenarios.note: Phase D observed gas_price ≈ 0.05 gwei on BSC mainnet at proposal time
20x baseline — heavy BSC congestion (e.g., during airdrop spike); should trigger S2 stop
100x baseline — should NEVER mint at this gas; S2 auto-aborts before submit

recommended_gas_price_ceiling_rationale: 0.5 gwei keeps round-trip gas cost under ~$0.30, well below the $0.50 mark-to-market stop (S10) and within the probe's already-accepted ~$1 worst-case loss budget. Above 0.5 gwei, the gas spike consumes more than 1.6x of the expected total cost — probe should be aborted and retried in a low-congestion window.
confidence_rationale: Gas units come from public observation ranges, not from a fresh eth_estimateGas. They're conservative upper bounds; real estimates with from=wallet will likely come in 10-30% lower. The CONFIDENCE is medium because no wallet address was used, not because the model is unsound.
next_stage_must_do: call eth_estimateGas with from=operator_wallet for: approve(USDT), approve(WBNB), mint, decreaseLiquidity, collect, approve(USDT,0), approve(WBNB,0)
compare each estimate to the conservative ceiling above; flag any that exceeds the conservative ceiling for human review
fetch current gas_price (eth_gasPrice) and check it's below the per-session ceiling
